## About
Damian Smith Auto Repair is a neighborhood shop on Oso Ave in Chatsworth. Damian handles everything from A/C and brakes to a full engine rebuild, on family cars, work vehicles and off-road rigs alike.
Chase DeLuca first came to Damian on the advice of his uncle Bill, a film studio mechanic who still brings the family car here. Chase later told his friend Justin Malvin, who made the drive up from Santa Monica to give Damian a try. Chase and Justin built this site because, as they put it, Damian is like family.
Reviewers call him honest and fair with his prices. One says he will even teach you about your car while he fixes it.

## Services
- A/C service & repair: No cold air, no air from the vents, or vents that won't switch.
- Electrical system repair: Turn signals, hazard lights, power windows and door locks that quit on you.
- Tires, Tire Rotation and Balancing: Tires shaking or wearing unevenly? Bring it in.
- Charging system repair (Alternators, Batteries, Starters): For hard starts, dead batteries and needing to be jumped a lot.
- Belts & Hoses, Water pumps: Belt noise, squealing and coolant leaks under the car.
- Full brake service & repair: Brake screech, pulsating brakes or uneven braking.
- Full steering & suspension repair: Power steering noise while turning, or shocks hitting hard.
- Full engine rebuild: When the engine needs more than a quick fix.

## FAQ
Q: When should I call Damian?
A: If you notice a weird noise, vibration, smell, electrical problem, fluid leak or light on the dashboard, call right away. Your safety could be at risk.

Q: Do you work on Jeeps and modified rigs?
A: Yes. Damian works on regular cars, modified rigs and rare vintage vehicles, and he's well known in the Jeep community.

Q: What are your hours?
A: Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM. The shop is closed Saturday and Sunday.
